source: NCERT Class XI, Fundamentals of Physical Geography, Ch. 6 (Landforms and their Evolution).

sections.heading: 1. Running Water (Fluvial) Landforms
points: Running water is the **most important** agent of gradation.
**Erosional:** V-shaped valleys, **gorges/canyons**, **waterfalls**, potholes, **meanders**, river terraces.
**Depositional:** **alluvial fans, floodplains, natural levees, deltas, ox-bow lakes**.
The river passes through youth, mature and old stages.

sections.heading: 2. Groundwater (Karst) Landforms
points: In **limestone (karst)** regions, groundwater dissolves rock (carbonation).
**Erosional:** **sinkholes, dolines, caves, valleys**.
**Depositional:** **stalactites (from ceiling), stalagmites (from floor), pillars**.
Named after the **Karst region** (Adriatic/former Yugoslavia).

sub: Erosional: **cirque, horn, arete, U-shaped valley, fjord, hanging valley**.
Erosional: **mushroom rocks, deflation hollows, yardangs, ventifacts**.

sections.heading: 4. Marine (Coastal) Landforms
points: Waves, currents and tides shape coasts.
**Erosional:** **sea cliffs, sea caves, sea arches, stacks, wave-cut platforms**.
**Depositional:** **beaches, spits, bars, lagoons**.
Coasts are classified as high-rocky or low-sedimentary.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Running water: V-valley, gorge, meander, ox-bow lake, delta, floodplain.
Karst (limestone): sinkholes, caves; stalactites (ceiling) & stalagmites (floor).
Glacial: cirque, horn, arete, U-valley, fjord, moraine, drumlin, esker.
Wind: mushroom rock, yardang, barchan dune, loess.
Marine: sea cliff, arch, stack, beach, spit, lagoon.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Stalactites hang from the ceiling; stalagmites rise from the floor** (do not swap).
**U-shaped valley = glacial**; **V-shaped valley = river**.
**Barchan** = crescent-shaped sand dune (wind).
**Ox-bow lake** forms from a cut-off river **meander**.
